# CLWA Engine Genre-Neutralization — Phase A Headline Verdict (INV-14)

**Branch:** `feature/engine-neutralization` · **tsc:** 0 errors · **tests:** 222/222 green · **Synthesis verified against current source.**

## Verdict: 8.5 / 10 — occasional-engine (high end), up from 7/10 baseline

Phase A did exactly what it set out to do: it **eliminated both always-on blocking prose leaks** that capped the engine at 7/10, and pushed the remaining crime vocabulary into a small set of inert residuals plus two consciously-deferred files. Two of the three re-probed genres independently re-rate the engine **module-only (9/10)**; the third (peaceful trading) lands at **8.5**. The honest *weighted* headline is **8.5** — I deliberately do **not** round up to 9, because the deferred PlayerJournal + IL accusation/evidence subsystem is genuine, un-extracted INV-14 debt that lives in the engine today. It ships *inert*, not *absent*.

## Before / After

| Dimension | Baseline (pre-Phase-A) | Now (post-Phase-A) | Verified in source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Weighted self-sufficiency | **7 / 10** | **8.5 / 10** | weighted across 3 probes (8.5 / 9 / 9) |
| Blocking leaks (always-on prose mis-render) | **2** (A2 role directive, A3 belief NL) | **0** | agent.ts:360-394 delegates; beliefs.ts → `phraseBelief()`; neutral fallback event-registry.ts:778-779 |
| Total crime-vocab leaks (non-deferred surface) | ~8 | **~3 genuine + inert comments** | volition.ts:170; event-projection.ts:10/26-28; world.ts:1300/1324 |
| Crime vocab in deferred files | (was inline everywhere) | **journal.ts 50 + il.ts 141 occ, quarantined** | grep-confirmed; gated behind crime-only entry points |
| Renamed primitives can regress | unguarded | **permanently banned** | tests/architecture.test.ts:146-171 |
| Module-satisfiable % (probed genres) | n/a | **93% / 92% / 97%** | trading / court / static-recount |

### What the A-changes actually accomplished (spot-verified, not taken on trust)
- **A1** conversation/overhear belief source → `BELIEF_SOURCE.GOSSIP` (world.ts:1309; event-registry GOSSIP universal).
- **A2** `buildRoleDirective` crime prose → `registerRoleDirectiveBuilder`; engine emits only belief-summary / relationships / motive (agent.ts:360-394). **This was a blocking leak. Gone.**
- **A3** belief NL → `phraseBelief()` with neutral engine fallback `"{who} — {verb} ({target})"`, explicitly "no wrongdoing framing" (event-registry.ts:766-780). **This was a blocking leak. Gone.**
- **A4a/A5/A6/A7** secret-directive aggregator, AffordanceRequirement open params bag + REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS/POST_TARGET checkers + registerTargetEnricher, open `capabilities: Record<string,boolean>` + `hasCapability()`, `EmotionalPressure.type: string` — all confirmed generic at the type level.
- **A8/A9** pre-seeded crime sources moved to module (engine keeps testimony/observation/evidence/gossip); `CrimeScene`→`SceneResidue`, `processKill`→`processAgentDeath`, callbacks renamed. Confirmed plus banned-from-regression.

## Remaining leak count: 13 line-clusters — split honestly

**Of the 13, only ~3 are genuine *non-deferred* semantic leaks; the rest are either the tracked deferred subsystem, inert comments, or documented boundary-layer (non-engine) residuals.**

### A. DEFERRED — tracked follow-up A10 + A4b (the dominant mass; NOT a new failure)
1. **`packages/engine/src/journal.ts` (entire file, 50 crime-vocab occ)** — PlayerJournal: clue/testimony/observation entry types, `markSuspect/isSuspect/getSuspects`, `getCaseSummary` (perpetratorName + quality strong/moderate/weak/insufficient), `crimeSceneId/suspectId/victimId/evidenceCategory`. Instantiated unconditionally (world.ts:141), but only fills on scene-residue examination or a transferable-belief overhear → a clean genre leaves it empty. **A10.**
2. **`packages/engine/src/il.ts:459-875` (141 crime-vocab occ)** — `PresentedEvidence`, `accusationHistory/formalAccusations`, `processEvidencePresentation` ("crime scene investigation" prose), `buildAccusationContext/buildAccusationPrompt` (crimeLabel / "FORMAL ACCUSATION" / "I am the law here" / investigator+canSentence gates), the accusation branch in `applyDialogueMeaning` gated by `isAccusationSpeechAct`. Dead code unless a module registers an `accusation:true` speech act + populates `presentedEvidence`. **A4b.**

> These two files hold **~191 of 455 (~42%)** of all remaining engine crime-vocab occurrences. That concentration is precisely why they are the named next extraction — and precisely why I hold the score at 8.5 rather than 9.

### B. GENUINE non-deferred residuals — real INV-14 debt, but NON-BLOCKING (inert)
3. **`volition.ts:170` — `hasCapability(agent.profile, 'investigator')`** — the single hardcoded crime-capability *string literal* in live engine code. Gates one debug `console.log`. Inert (no module → branch never logs), but the engine literally names a crime capability. Fix: drop the gate or key it on a generic capability.
4. **`event-projection.ts:10/26-28` + `event-types.ts:18` — `wantedSubjects` cluster** — pursuit-flavored field, populated via the *generic* `isPursuitEvent()` registry gate with `event.subject ??` primary and a `perpetratorName` fallback. Naming leak, behaviorally neutral. Fix: rename → `pursuedSubjects`.
5. **`world.ts:1300` — overhear prose `"may be involved in {verb}"`** — mild investigation framing applied to **all** transferable-belief overhears (quasi-always-on). Reads slightly off for "may be involved in price-cutting" but stays grammatical → cosmetic, non-blocking. Best folded into the `phraseBelief` delegation.
6. **`world.ts:1324-1332`** — player overhear auto-creates a journal observation entry, routing a neutral overhear into the crime-coded journal. Gated on `isPlayer && overheardClaim && this.journal`.

### C. INERT comments / documented boundary residuals (counted, zero runtime effect)
7. Inert crime-vocab **comments**: world-types.ts:114-150 (SceneResidue JSDoc; fields themselves neutral actorId/affectedId/sceneType), world.ts callback/field comments (incl. the `processAgentDeath` `perpetratorName` *local* + "crime scene" comments at 1538-1592 — confined to the death/scene path a crime-free genre never invokes), beliefs.ts:41/121 comments, al.ts:55-83 StepTemplate JSDoc + interpolation var names.
8. **`cg-engine.ts` payload reads `perpetratorName/affectedName`** — DOCUMENTED ACCEPTABLE untyped payload bag, graceful fallback to subject/object/'someone'.
9. **`server/src/ws.ts:28,31`** ('murder'/'crime:scene'/crimeType WS union) and **`server/src/index.ts:149,155`** (bootstrap mixes crime claim-sources + pressure types) — **NOT engine**; game-UI / wiring layer. A non-crime genre swaps the bootstrap wiring, not engine code.

> Note on `evidence.ts` (59 occ) and `BODY_DISCOVERY`: correctly **not** counted as leaks. `Evidence` is a genre-neutral discoverable-fact registry (category is module-defined: "crime: motive/trace; economy: transaction") with empty `EVIDENCE_RULES`/`EVIDENCE_SOURCES`. Body discovery is a universal mortality-perception phase with the concrete event type module-registered. Both are universal constructs with borderline naming, not module knowledge.

## Blocking-leak count: **0** (non-deferred surface)
No engine path mis-renders or crashes on a crime-free world. The two baseline blocking prose paths (A2/A3) are drained and their neutrality is now enforced by a permanent test. Crash-safety holds: `getBodyDiscoveryEventType()→null` short-circuits; `processAgentDeath`/`createSceneResidue` throw only when explicitly invoked with crime data; EvidenceLayer/CG/STEP_HANDLERS are empty-registry no-ops.

## The single bounded remaining investment
Finish **A10 + A4b**: generalize `PlayerJournal` → a neutral typed-record "notebook," and lift the IL accusation/evidence-presentation subsystem into the crime module (delegating its prose through the existing `phraseBelief`/role-directive hooks, which also cleans up the `world.ts:1300` "may be involved in" and the IL "against" artifact). Trivially alongside: rename `wantedSubjects→pursuedSubjects` and drop/genericize the `volition.ts:170` debug gate. Completing this would remove the two deferred files from the architecture-test exclusion list and lift the engine to **module-only (9-10)** across all genres.

## Honest framing
This is a real, source-verified improvement: **+1.5 points, both blocking leaks eliminated, a permanent regression guard installed, and the residual crime knowledge collapsed from "smeared across the engine" to "two named files behind crime-only gates."** It is **not** yet a clean physics engine — the engine still *contains* a crime-investigation subsystem it should not, and it ships inert rather than absent. That is the precise, non-rationalized reason the headline is high-end occasional-engine (8.5), not module-only (9). The per-genre 9s are correct *for those genres* (they never reach the deferred surface); the weighted floor honestly reflects that the INV-14 boundary is near-perfect but not literally complete.

### A1–A9 landing confirmed (read actual current source)
| Change | Verified in source |

| A1 conversation belief source → `BELIEF_SOURCE.GOSSIP` | world.ts:1181,1194,1309 (conversation + overhear transfer all use GOSSIP, not 'rumor'). event-registry.ts:332-342 defines GOSSIP as engine-universal. |

Baseline was 7/10 occasional-engine, ~8 leaks. Phase A drained those; the live engine is materially cleaner.

### Trading-genre needs → engine landing spot (all SATISFIABLE)
- **Browse shop / inventory** → `AgentProfile.shop: ShopItem[]` (agent-types.ts:119-124), consumed by server routes/ws/world-loader. ✓
- **"Show me your wares" / buy / sell / haggle** → IL `tradeIntent` is **first-class in the engine** (il.ts:72-75,155-160,374-380) with semantic correction forcing trade speechAct (il.ts:283-301). Trade speechAct + buy/sell/browse verbs registered (server/index.ts:146,150). ✓
- **Ask price / opinion of a vendor** → IL questions → belief gather via `phraseBelief` (neutral). questionTopics registry. ✓
- **Produce / sell goods as an NPC action** → AL affordance with module step type; volition.ts:975 generic default step handler resolves ANY registered step (`trade` listed as example). actionVerb via registerActionVerbs. ✓
- **"Garrett undercut my prices" belief spreading NPC→NPC and via overhear** → conversation/overhear transfer gated by `isTransferable`, source GOSSIP, any eventType (e.g. PRICE_UNDERCUT). ✓
- **Vendor rivalry / mood / sentiment from competition** → mood modifiers, sentimentCurve, social-stress drift, CG rules on economy event types — all registry/data driven. ✓
- **Player asks NPC to do something (e.g. "stock more bread")** → IL requestedAction → getAffordanceIdsForVerb → goalCreator. ✓
- **Reputation / "who is a fair trader"** → relationships + beliefs + capabilities (e.g. `isMerchant`). ✓

**Module-satisfiable ≈ 93%.** The ~7% gap = the deferred PlayerJournal + IL accusation/evidence subsystem, which a peaceful trading player has no analogue for (no case, no suspects, no evidence presentation).

### Remaining crime leaks this genre would hit — and why NONE are blocking
1. **journal.ts PlayerJournal (A10, deferred).** Crime-coded throughout (clue/testimony/observation types, suspects, case summary quality strong/moderate/weak/insufficient, perpetratorName/crimeSceneId). A trading player has nothing to investigate. **Non-blocking**: the journal only fills when (a) a crime scene is examined or (b) a transferable-belief overhear occurs. A pure trading world registers no scene-residue templates and (if desired) no transferable economy beliefs, so it stays empty. The one live path that touches it on a neutral overhear is world.ts:1324-1333 — but only fires for the *player* agent AND only when `overheardClaim` is non-empty, which a trading genre can avoid by phrasing/transferability config. Inert, not mis-rendering.
2. **il.ts evidence-presentation + accusation (A4b, deferred).** `processEvidencePresentation` only runs if `ctx.presentedEvidence` is populated (a crime client feeds this; a trade client never does). The accusation branch (il.ts:771) is gated by `isAccusationSpeechAct(speechAct)` — no module registers an `accusation:true` speech act in a trading genre, so the whole branch is **dead code**. Inert, not blocking.
3. **world.ts:1300 overheardClaim prose "may be involved in <verb>".** Mild investigation framing applied to all transferable-belief overhears. Would read slightly off for "may be involved in price-cutting" but still grammatical/usable — cosmetic, **non-blocking**.
4. **al.ts:55-83 StepTemplate JSDoc + crime interpolation vars** (perpetratorName/crimeLocation/crimeType/'crime beliefs'). Comment/var-name residual; the interpolation engine is generic ({var:fallback}). Inert.
5. **Inert comments**: world-types.ts:114-150 (SceneResidue "crime scene"/"perpetrator"/"victim" JSDoc; fields themselves neutral), world.ts callback comments, beliefs.ts comments, cg-engine.ts comments. Pure documentation; zero runtime effect.
6. **cg-engine.ts payload reads perpetratorName/affectedName** (DOCUMENTED ACCEPTABLE) — untyped payload bag with graceful fallback to event.subject/object/'someone'. Works for any genre.
7. **Boundary-adjacent (NOT engine):** server/src/index.ts:149,155 IL-vocab wiring still mixes crime claim-sources ('suspects','deduced') and pressure types ('threat','bribe','intimidation','guilt') into the shared bootstrap; server/src/ws.ts:28,31 'murder'/'crime:scene'/crimeType WS union. These are the documented game-UI/wiring residuals — a trading genre swaps the bootstrap wiring, not engine code.

### Crash-safety on a crime-free world
No engine path crashes without crime data: `getBodyDiscoveryEventType()`→null short-circuits body discovery (world.ts:1349); `getDefaultDeathEvent()` only throws inside `processAgentDeath`, never auto-invoked; createSceneResidue throws only if a sceneType is explicitly requested with no template (a trading world requests none); EvidenceLayer/CG/STEP_HANDLERS are empty-registry no-ops.

### Verdict vs the 7/10 baseline
**Re-rated to 8.5/10 — occasional-engine (up from 7/10).** Phase A neutralized every baseline leak; the two clusters this genre would still touch (PlayerJournal A10, IL accusation/evidence A4b) are **inert for trading** — they sit behind crime-only gates (`isAccusationSpeechAct`, scene-residue templates, presentedEvidence) that a peaceful trading genre never trips, so they neither mis-render nor crash. They remain "engine knows a domain it shouldn't" (real INV-14 debt) which keeps this short of module-only(9-10); the single bounded remaining investment is finishing A10+A4b (generalize PlayerJournal → a neutral "notebook" of typed records, and lift the accusation/evidence-presentation subsystem into the module). With those done, this genre would be module-only. No blocking leaks → not frequent-engine. Hence high-end occasional-engine.

# Re-probe: Royal-Court Romance & Intrigue vs. Neutralized Engine (Phase A)

## Verdict: module-only (9/10) — UP from 7/10 occasional-engine baseline

Phase A neutralization lands cleanly and **fully resolves the one bug that blocked this genre at baseline**: the courtier "investigating the courtship of X" mis-render. The remaining crime vocab is now quarantined entirely inside the consciously-deferred investigation/accusation/journal subsystem (`il.ts` + `journal.ts`, A10+A4b), which a non-violent court genre **never reaches** unless it opts in. Verified against current source on `feature/engine-neutralization`: tsc 0 errors, 222/222 tests pass.

## Genre definition as data
- **Win = social standing** (relationship sentiment/trust + favor capability), not survival.
- **Actions**: court, flatter, compliment, confide, ally, scheme, bribe-for-favor, spread gossip, withhold/reveal a secret. All non-violent.
- **Roles (capabilities)**: `canGrantFavor`, `isRival`, `isPatron`, `isConfidant` — declared as data, not engine-typed.
- **Events**: COURTED, ALLIANCE_FORMED, FAVOR_GRANTED, SECRET_SHARED, INTRIGUE_PLOTTED — registered transferable so they gossip.

## Trace each need to its engine landing spot

| Court need | Engine landing spot | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Court/flatter/scheme **affordances** | `AFFORDANCE_REGISTRY` + `computeUtility` (pure OCEAN+H) | OK — genre-neutral scorer, proven by Economy test (`tests/genre-neutrality.test.ts:125-146`) |
| Court action verbs reach LLM enum | `registerActionVerbs` (INV-10) | OK |
| Roles (canGrantFavor etc.) | `AgentProfile.capabilities: Record<string,boolean>` + `hasCapability()` (**A6**, `agent-types.ts:104-116`) | OK — open map, no engine edit |
| "Aldric courted Bess" belief NL | `phraseBelief()` registry + **neutral fallback** `"{who} — {verb} ({target})"` (**A3**, `event-registry.ts:766-780`) | **FIXED** — fallback has NO wrongdoing framing |
| Courtier's role-section prose | `getRoleDirectiveBuilders()` (**A2**, `agent.ts:376-378`); engine emits only universal belief/relationship/motive sections | **FIXED** — engine never frames a belief as a "crime"/"investigation" |
| NPC-NPC gossip about courtship | `BELIEF_SOURCE.GOSSIP` (**A1/A8**, `world.ts:1181/1194/1309`) + `transferBeliefs` uses `TESTIMONY` (`goals.ts:171`) | OK — engine-universal sources only |
| Affordance gates (atCourt, hasStanding) | `REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS`/`POST_TARGET_REQUIREMENT_CHECKERS` + open `[key:string]` params bag (**A5**, `al.ts:9-27`) | OK |
| Target enrichment (rival/patron flags) | `registerTargetEnricher` (**A5**) | OK |
| Emotional pressure (flattery/bribe/guilt) | `EmotionalPressure.type: string` registry-backed (**A7**, `il.ts:148-153`) + server `registerPressureTypes` (already includes flattery, bribe, guilt) | OK |
| Player claims "X is allied with Y" | IL claim path (`il.ts:721-769`) — `isTransferable` + `BELIEF_SOURCE.TESTIMONY` + `getEventLabelSafe` | OK (genre-neutral) — one mild prose artifact, see below |
| Scene aftermath (a tryst discovered, a torn letter) | `SceneResidue` (sceneType/actorId/affectedId) (**A9**, `scene-residue.ts`) | OK — explicitly genre-neutral |

## Why the baseline blocker is gone
At 7/10 baseline, two always-on prompt paths hardcoded crime English: `agent.buildRoleDirective` framed any belief as "you are investigating the murder/courtship of X", and `beliefs.summarizeForPrompt/Memory` rendered "X committed VERB against Y". For a court NPC holding a COURTED belief this produced the absurd "investigating the courtship of X" / "committed courtship against Y". **A2 + A3 moved 100% of that prose into the crime module** (`crime-justice/index.ts:641-691`) behind `registerBeliefPhrasing`/`registerRoleDirectiveBuilder`. The engine fallbacks are now neutral. A court module supplies its own phrasing ("X courted Y", "X formed an alliance with Y") and its own role directives. This is the decisive change.

## Remaining crime leaks — all NON-BLOCKING for this genre
Every remaining leak lives in the **deferred A10+A4b investigation/accusation/journal subsystem** and is **gated/inert** for a non-violent court genre:

1. **Accusation branch** (`il.ts:772-846`) — fires ONLY when a speech act with `accusation:true` is registered AND the NPC has `investigator`/`canSentence`. A court genre registers neither, so `isAccusationSpeechAct` is false → entire branch (incl. "I am the law here" at :785, `buildAccusationContext`/`buildAccusationPrompt` crime prose) is dead code. Inert, not mis-rendering.
2. **Evidence presentation** (`il.ts:518-573`) — runs unconditionally but early-returns unless `ctx.presentedEvidence` is non-empty; that array is populated only by the crime journal/evidence UI. "crime scene investigation" prose at :571 never renders for court. Inert.
3. **PlayerJournal** (`journal.ts` — `crimeSceneId`/`suspectId`/`victimId`/`perpetratorName`/`markSuspect`/`getCaseSummary`) is always instantiated at `world.ts:142`, but a court genre simply never calls its crime-named methods. Dead surface, not a mis-render.
4. **Mild prose artifact (only quasi-always-on item)**: `il.ts:762-763` claim-feedback renders "{subject} was involved in {label} **against** {object}". For a COURTED claim this reads "Aldric was involved in courtship against Bess" — the word "against" is a faint crime-leaning artifact. It is grammatically odd but NOT a hard mis-render (the LLM still gets the right entities + event label), and it is bounded to the player-claim path. Worth folding into the A3 phrasing delegation when A4b is extracted, but does not block.

The permanent regression guard (`tests/architecture.test.ts:112-160`) proves the **rest of the engine** (39 of 41 files) carries zero crime prose and zero crime-named primitives; only `journal.ts` + `il.ts` are excluded as tracked-deferred.

## Self-sufficiency: ~92% module-satisfiable, no blocking leaks
